title: MACE-MP-0 Known Failure Modes
model_scope: Original MACE-MP-0 ('0a', mostly the medium model) unless noted. Later variants (0b, 0b2, 0b3, MPA-0, OMAT-0) are referenced in status fields.

evidence_grades.direct: MACE-MP-0 explicitly tested in the cited work.
evidence_grades.inherited: Shown for the MPtrj training data or for sibling models trained on it; applies to MACE-MP-0 by construction.
evidence_grades.direct+inherited: Both direct tests and inherited evidence exist.
evidence_grades.direct (mixed): Direct tests exist but results conflict across studies.

failure_modes.name: Systematic PES softening
failure_modes.symptom: Energies, forces and PES curvature under-predicted away from equilibrium.
failure_modes.root_cause: Near-equilibrium sampling bias of the MPtrj training set.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: Reduced in MPA-0 / OMAT-0; correctable by fine-tuning.

findings.text: M3GNet, CHGNet and MACE-MP-0 all under-predict energies and forces across surfaces, defects, solid solutions, phonons, ion-migration barriers and high-energy states; cause is under-predicted PES curvature. A single extra DFT point in fine-tuning largely corrects it.
EC/EMC carbonate liquid with MACE-MP-0 + D3 gave a density of ~0.72 g/cm3 (too low), attributed to softening.

failure_modes.notes: F2-F6 are largely specific manifestations of F1.

failure_modes.name: Under-estimated or imaginary phonons
failure_modes.symptom: Optical modes too soft; spurious imaginary modes (e.g. MOFs); phonon DOS errors.
failure_modes.root_cause: PES softening plus few displaced configurations in training data.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: Partly fixed in MACE-MP-0b3; MACE-OMAT-0 much better.

findings.text: Under-estimates high-frequency optical modes relative to PBE across 103 compounds.
In MOFs, reproduces equilibrium structures but gives imaginary modes and poor phonon DOS; fixed by fine-tuned MACE-MP-MOF0.
Inelastic neutron scattering benchmark: phonon DOS agreement worse than MACE-MPA-0 (mean Spearman 0.85 vs 0.89).
Double halide perovskites: phonon bandwidth error with MP-0 about 1-2 THz; later MACE models improve.
Context: a broad benchmark ranks MACE-MP-0 second of seven uMLIPs for harmonic phonons, so the failure is quantitative rather than catastrophic for typical inorganic crystals.

failure_modes.name: Poor lattice thermal conductivity
failure_modes.symptom: Large errors in thermal conductivity and Grueneisen parameters despite decent force accuracy.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: Not addressed within the MP-0 line.

findings.text: Large mode-resolved conductivity errors vs DFT-PBE across 103 compounds; conductivity and Grueneisen errors are uncorrelated.
Across 2,429 OQMD materials, force accuracy comparable to EquiformerV2 but IFC discrepancies led to poor thermal-conductivity predictions.

failure_modes.notes: Good force MAE does not guarantee good anharmonic properties.

failure_modes.name: Surface and cleavage energies too low

findings.text: On Materials Project surfaces, MACE was the most accurate of three uMLIPs but mostly under-estimated surface energies; errors correlate with out-of-domain distance.
Surface energies are one of the softening benchmarks.

failure_modes.name: Defect energies and migration barriers
failure_modes.symptom: Vacancy and migration energies under-estimated; wrong PES topology in some defect systems.
failure_modes.root_cause: PES softening; magnetic and defect configurations out-of-distribution.

findings.text: Defect energies and ion-migration barriers systematically under-predicted.
Ag-Li: pure vacancy migration barriers lower than DFT (attributed to softening), though within ~0.05 eV.
Iron sulfides (preprint): flat or wrong-topology PES, [Fe4S4] cubane collapse, unphysical energies / non-convergence on ferrimagnetic greigite, and 1.2-1.5x under-binding where converged.
Counter-evidence: across 574 battery-relevant NEB paths, MACE-MP-0 had the lowest full-set MAE of six foundation models.

failure_modes.name: Mechanical properties
failure_modes.symptom: Elastic constants and stacking-fault energies inaccurate.
failure_modes.root_cause: PES softening; few strained configurations in training.

findings.text: Limited accuracy for elastic constants and stacking-fault energies in elemental alloys.
LAMBench elastic constants: largest error of the ten models listed.
Benchmark on ~11,000 MP materials: MACE mid-pack; fine-tuning on strained configurations degraded it by ~14%, unlike the other three models.

failure_modes.name: High pressure
failure_modes.symptom: Accuracy degrades from 0 to 150 GPa; wrong pressure trends for phase transitions.
failure_modes.root_cause: Almost no compressed structures in MPtrj.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: MACE-MP-0b2 and MPA-0 improve high-pressure stability.

findings.text: uMLIP accuracy deteriorates considerably from 0 to 150 GPa due to training-data coverage; targeted fine-tuning fixes it.
MACE-MP-0b2 released to improve high-pressure stability via repulsion regularisation and extra high-pressure examples.
Fe-Ni: MACE foundation models predict an incorrect rise of the bcc-to-hcp transition pressure with Ni content, linked to magnetic collapse.

failure_modes.name: Short-range repulsion and isolated atoms
failure_modes.symptom: Atoms can approach unphysically closely in hot/high-energy MD; wrong isolated-atom energies and dissociation asymptotes.
failure_modes.root_cause: No close-contact training data; isolated-atom (E0) treatment.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: Fixed in MACE-MP-0b (core repulsion, corrected isolated atoms).

findings.text: MACE-MP-0b released to improve pair repulsion and correct isolated-atom energies; 0b-series adds core repulsion for more stable MD.

failure_modes.name: Missing dispersion (van der Waals)
failure_modes.symptom: Molecular liquids evaporate; densities too low; layered and molecular systems under-bound.
failure_modes.root_cause: PBE reference data contain no dispersion.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: Not in the model; add D3 at runtime.

findings.text: Original paper and docs recommend adding D3 for molecular and layered systems.
Without D3, an EC/EMC carbonate liquid evaporates rapidly in MD; with D3 it is stable but under-dense.

failure_modes.name: Mixed PBE / PBE+U energy surfaces
failure_modes.symptom: Under-binding or spurious repulsion between U-corrected metals and O/F species (oxidation, adsorption).
failure_modes.root_cause: Materials Project applies +U to certain transition metals only when O or F is present, creating two incompatible PESs.
failure_modes.status_in_later_variants: Persists in MPA-0 / OMAT-0; avoided by models trained on +U-free data (e.g. MatPES).

findings.text: Models trained on MPtrj, Alexandria or OMat24 interpolate between the GGA and GGA+U surfaces, causing under-binding or spurious repulsion between U-metals and O/F species.
PBE/PBE+U mixing flagged as a source of non-smooth PES features in MP-derived data.
Anomalous O/F adsorption energies on U-block metal surfaces independently rediscovered for MACE-MPA-0.

failure_modes.notes: Strongest tests are on MPA-0 / OMAT-0; MACE-MP-0 is trained on the same mixed data.

failure_modes.name: No magnetism
failure_modes.symptom: Cannot distinguish magnetic orderings; fails on magnetic collapse and ferrimagnetic phases.
failure_modes.root_cause: No spin degrees of freedom in the model.

findings.text: uMLIPs without spin inputs represent an averaged PES over magnetic configurations and cannot resolve magnetic ordering.
Fe-Ni: magnetic collapse under pressure and magnetoelastic effects not captured.
Ferrimagnetic greigite: unphysical energies and non-convergence.

failure_modes.name: Molecular chemistry, adsorption and catalysis
failure_modes.symptom: Large errors on reaction energies, conformers, CO/CO2 adsorption.
failure_modes.root_cause: Few molecules or adsorbates in MPtrj; PBE level of theory.

findings.text: Less accurate than MACE-Osaka24 on Transition1x reactions and CO adsorption on high-entropy-alloy nanoparticles (CO adsorption RMSE 0.27-0.41 eV).
LAMBench: scores 0.64 / 0.72 / 0.59 on molecules / inorganic / catalysis; largest Wiggle150 conformer error among listed models.
CO2 adsorption in ZIF-8, ZIF-4 and Mg-MOF-74 (GCMC): MACE-MP-0a and 0b3 show systematic over- or under-estimation.

mitigations.mitigation: Fine-tune on a handful of task-specific DFT configurations (even one point helps with softening).
Use MACE-MP-0b2 / MPA-0, or fine-tune on compressed structures.
Prefer models trained on +U-free data (e.g. MatPES-based), or shift-correct +U energies before fine-tuning.
No fix within MACE-MP-0; use spin-aware models or DFT.
